item.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture
summary:      Establish the application structure and module boundaries.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md, cli.md
provides:     app_server.main:create_app, cli.main, persistence.open_database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the Python application structure and the ownership boundaries described in ARCHITECTURE.md. Keep database access behind the shipped persistence library.

## story database
summary:      Declare the rates schema and repository operations.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, sqlite.md, persistence.md
depends:      architecture
provides:     rates.get, rates.list, rates.upsert, rates.delete
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Declare the rates table and typed repository operations needed by initialization, loading, and API reads. Include acceptance for every declared operation.

## story initialize_store
summary:      Initialize an empty rates store from the command line.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Initialize.md
covers:       DATA-001
accepts:      st-008
stack:        python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture, database
provides:     fxrates init
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement fxrates init so it drops and recreates the rates table empty, using the persistence boundary and configured database location.

## story load_history
summary:      Validate and load ECB history CSV files atomically.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Load.md
covers:       DATA-002
accepts:      st-003, st-008
context:      sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
stack:        python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture, database
provides:     fxrates load
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Validate the entire CSV before writing. Store non-N/A rates as their published text, replace matching date and currency rows, and report the date and rate counts.

## story fetch_history
summary:      Fetch and load the ECB history archive.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Fetch.md
covers:       DATA-003
accepts:      st-009
stack:        python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture, database, load_history
provides:     fxrates fetch
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Download the ECB archive, extract eurofxref-hist.csv, and pass it through the same validation and storage behavior as fxrates load. Tests must stub the download.

## story cli_errors
summary:      Handle CLI usage errors and operational failures.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Errors.md
covers:       CLI-001
accepts:      st-002
stack:        python.md, cli.md
depends:      architecture, initialize_store, load_history, fetch_history, serve_api
provides:     fxrates usage and failure responses
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement the documented command usage and failure exit codes. Failures write no stdout and one diagnostic line to stderr. Provide bin/test.sh for the project pytest suite.

## story serve_api
summary:      Start the API server on the requested local port.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Serve.md
covers:       CLI-002
accepts:      st-004
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, cli.md
depends:      architecture
provides:     fxrates serve
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Run uvicorn in the foreground on 127.0.0.1, honor --port with default 8000, and stop cleanly on SIGTERM.

## story api_health_stats
summary:      Report API health and stored rate statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Health-Stats.md
covers:       API-001
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture, database, load_history
provides:     GET /health, GET /stats
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement health and statistics responses, including null date bounds when no rates are stored.

## story api_currencies
summary:      List the base and available currencies.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Currencies.md
covers:       API-002
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture, database, load_history
provides:     GET /currencies
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Return EUR as the base and stored currencies in ascending order.

## story api_rates
summary:      Retrieve rates for a requested or latest effective date.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Rates.md
covers:       API-003
accepts:      st-005, st-007
context:      sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture, database, load_history
provides:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /rates/latest
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Resolve requests to the latest publication on or before the date. Return 404 when none exists and 422 for malformed dates.

## story api_convert
summary:      Convert amounts between currencies using exact decimal arithmetic.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-Convert.md
covers:       API-004
accepts:      st-005, st-006, st-007, st-008
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture, database, load_history
provides:     GET /convert
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement conversion with exact Decimal arithmetic and half-even rounding. Validate amount and date inputs, resolve the effective date, and return 404 for unavailable currencies or dates.

## story api_history
summary:      Retrieve currency history and exact summary statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-History.md
covers:       API-005
accepts:      st-006, st-007, st-008
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      architecture, database, load_history
provides:     GET /history/{code}
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Return ascending points within inclusive optional bounds and compute min, max, and mean with exact Decimal arithmetic. Return null statistics for an empty range and 404 for a currency with no stored rate.

## story conformance
summary:      Pass the supplied end-to-end conformance grader.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   VERIFICATION.md
covers:       VERIFY-001
accepts:      st-001
context:      sources/run.sh, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md, cli.md
depends:      initialize_store, load_history, fetch_history, cli_errors, serve_api, api_health_stats, api_currencies, api_rates, api_convert, api_history
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Run the supplied grader as the terminal full-suite acceptance gate. Keep all staged sources assets unchanged.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
